description: Upscale an image 2x or 4x with AI. Costs 8 credits for 2x and 12 for 4x, refunded if it fails. Needs a CropDen API key. Input: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 10 MB; longest side up to 2048 px for 2x or 1024 px for 4x. Returns a link to the result, valid 7 days.

image_base64.description: The image as base64 (a data: URL is fine). Use instead of image_url for local files.

image_url.description: Public https URL of a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

name: ai_upscale_image
title: AI image upscaler
